routes_to_goal: main switchback path through meadow, lake, bridge, snow slope
coastal beach/tidepool/marsh route into hidden cave shortcut
riskier crystal ridge and cinder field route with steeper triangular obstacles
map_design.coverage_rule: Every longitude band has a biome patch, path segment, or landmark; high latitudes are snow/rock, low water edges have sand or marsh.

terrain_coverage.coverage_method: actual generated terrain-shell triangle area union, using each shell face center to assign one spherical biome region
terrain_coverage.terrain_patch_mesh_rule: Large terrain is cut from the spherical terrain shell into continuous triangulated biome regions. Triangles are mesh topology only, not visible triangle-pile terrain props.

terrain_patch_coverage.coverage_method: actual generated terrain-shell triangle area union, using each shell face center to assign one spherical biome region
terrain_patch_coverage.terrain_patch_mesh_rule: Large terrain is cut from the spherical terrain shell into continuous triangulated biome regions. Triangles are mesh topology only, not visible triangle-pile terrain props.

fidelity_target.matching_rule: The complete planet shell uses thousands of flat-shaded low-poly faces and explicit biome materials, so its scene-level density is no longer below the Pico character asset.
